claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Ilomastat is a broad-spectrum hydroxamate MMP inhibitor that at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a direct cytotoxic agent, since MMP inhibition does not acutely kill cancer cells in 5-day viability assays.
